content:
alyssa: Quick kickoff — we need to coordinate a phased base-image rebuild next week. Goals: minimize runtime surface, rotate KMS signing key, update image-pusher RBAC, and confirm audit-log retention for compliance. Also triage any leftover Alpine/CVE items before cutover. Who can own each piece?

priyanka: I can own RBAC changes. Question: do we want one image-pusher SA per cluster (dev/stage/prod) or per repo? lean toward per-cluster for ops simplicity. :thinking_face:

jordan: For KMS/signing I can handle key lifecycle. Plan: create new key versions in KMS, publish public key to attestation service, update cosign config, roll signing in canaries, then cutover. Need downtime window for the signing rotation? We can do key rotation without downtime if we keep old key active for verification during rollout.

sam: Triage volunteer here for vuln scanning. I'll run a full SBOM + Clair scan on the candidate base images and produce a short list of blockers. If we still see that alpine CVE-2026-XY1, we'll patch to 3.20.5 and rebase.

ops-bot: [CI] build:base-image-rebuild #5567 started by alyssa
ops-bot: [CI] build:base-image-rebuild #5567 image-sign step failed: cosign: private key not found

priyanka: ops-bot failure is expected if cosign key hasn't been provisioned to the runner. Jordan, can you publish the temporary key to the CI KMS for the canary runs?

jordan: Will do. Steps I plan:
1) create key version: gcloud kms keys versions create --key=redwood-image-signer --location=global --keyring=images
2) grant ci-runner kms.cryptoSign on the new key version
3) update CI secret: export COSIGN_PRIVATE_KEY via kms decrypt in the runner
4) run canary sign and verify with cosign verify --key <pubkey> <image>

sam: For vuln triage, command I'll run: 
```
./infra/tools/scan-image.sh gcr.io/redwood/base:2026-03-01 --sbom --policy=medium
```
I'll attach results to the checklist.

priyanka: RBAC plan draft: create image-pusher role with just: storage.objects.get/create, containerregistry.images.upload, and kms.cryptoSign permission only for the signing key. Bindings: image-pusher@clusters/dev -> dev key, image-pusher@clusters/prod -> prod key. Thoughts? :thumbsup:

sec-eng-ken: A couple of compliance points:
- Audit logging: we must retain image push/sign events for 365 days. Export KMS audit logs + GCR push logs to secure GCS bucket with object-level immutability.
- Alerting: any cosign verification failure should trigger PagerDuty sev2; we should add a verification step in the deployment pipeline that gates rollout.

alyssa: Good call. Priyanka, can you add the immutability/GCS bucket name to the RBAC PR? Ken, can you write the alert rule? I'll add the PagerDuty escalation policy.

priyanka: Yep — I'll open PR against infra-iam with the role and binding templates and include a short rationale for reviewers. ETA EOD today.

jordan: KMS note: to avoid accidental key exposure, we'll use KMS-as-a-service with sign-only grant. No private key material in plaintext in CI. Use cosign's kms: `cosign sign --key gcpkms://projects/..../locations/..../keyRings/.../cryptoKeys/...`

sam: Found two medium vuln rows in the scan: 
- libssl 1.1.1k (fixed in 1.1.1m) -> needs rebuild or patch
- busybox config -> rebuild with minimal applets, but not a blocker for rollout
I'll include the CVE IDs in the report.

ops-bot: [CI] build:base-image-rebuild #5570 started by priyanka
ops-bot: [CI] build:base-image-rebuild #5570 image-sign step succeeded (cosign)

priyanka: Signing succeeded on canary image. Pushed canary tag to gcr.io/redwood/base:canary-2026-03-02. Verification: cosign verify --key <pubkey> gcr.io/redwood/base:canary-2026-03-02 -> OK

sec-eng-ken: Drafted alert: 
- name: ImageSignVerificationFail
- condition: cosign.verify.failure > 0 for 1m
- handlers: pagerduty-image-sigs
- runbook: https://redwood.example.com/runbooks/image-sign-failure
(added to Splunk alerts)

alyssa: Nice. Action items we have now: 
- priyanka: open RBAC PR + bucket immutability settings (ETA EOD)
- jordan: provision KMS key versions and update CI secrets (ETA tomorrow morning)
- sam: full scan report + CVE list (ETA tomorrow noon)
- ken: alert + runbook (ETA tomorrow)
I'll schedule a 30m sync Monday 9:30am to confirm cutover plan and canary metrics (latency, image-pull rates, sign/verify latency).

jordan: One more ops note — during rollout, the image registry may emit increased pull rates for canaries. We should bump rate-limits for the burst window. I'll open a quick change with infra networking.

priyanka: PR created: https://git.redwood/infrastructure/infra-iam/pull/189 — includes role, example binding, and bucket policy. Ping me for reviews. :sparkles:

sam: Uploading scan results: attaching SBOM + csv to the ticket. TL;DR: 2 medium, 0 high. Recommend proceed with canary but patch libssl in next minor.

ops-bot: [CI] build:base-image-rebuild #5570 promoted to rollout-canary by priyanka

alyssa: Great progress. If anything pops that blocks (high vuln or signing failures) we abort and revert. Otherwise proceed with staged rollout after Monday sync. Thanks all. :clap:

priyanka: ACK. I'll shepherd the RBAC review.

sec-eng-ken: I'll finalize the runbook and attach the PagerDuty play.

jordan: Keys created and binding applied to CI principal. Pushed public key to attestation service.

alyssa: Closing thread — see you on Monday.
